description_zh: 批量删除站点监控的任务
name: DeleteTasks

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site monitoring task, which is the unique identifier for the task
parameters.help_zh: 站点监控的任务Id，任务的唯一标识
parameters.name: task_ids

parameters.help_en:
Whether to delete the alarm rules associated with the task. The default value is 1.

1: Delete the alarm rules as well
0: Do not delete the alarm rules, only delete the task
parameters.help_zh:
是否删除任务关联的报警规则，默认值为1。

1:同时删除报警规则
0:不删除报警规则，只删除任务
parameters.name: is_delete_alarms
